free_tier.stated: No free tier. Cheapest offer read: VN-1A KVM VPS in Hanoi, Vietnam, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB SSD, 1 TB monthly traffic, 200 Mbps port, 1 dedicated IPv4, USD 18.50 per year at the regular price, or USD 14.80 per year with coupon LOWEND20. The cart page lists a monthly billing cycle of VND 60,000 without naming the plan it applies to.
free_tier.notes: the cart page also lists VN-2 (1 vCore, 2 GB, 25 GB, 2 TB), VN3 (2 vCore, 2 GB, 25 GB, 5 TB) and larger plans up to VN-128; their prices were not shown

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not stored bytes; the vendor states a 7-day money-back period on VN-1A
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process and its disk

egress.terms: 1 TB of monthly traffic on VN-1A over a 200 Mbps port; the vendor's home page also states that its VPS services have unlimited data transfer, which the 1 TB plan figure contradicts

interface_detail: a management panel with start, stop, reboot, password reset and reinstall, and a VNC console; no API was read
tooling: panel and VNC console; the vendor lists Linux and Windows images; no API or CLI was read
chaining: USD 18.50 per year buys 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 20 GB of SSD with 1 TB of monthly traffic in Hanoi, Vietnam.

limits.value: 1 TB of monthly traffic on VN-1A

limits_note: The vendor's home page states unlimited data transfer for all its VPS services, while the plan page and the vendor's forum post both state 1 TB for VN-1A; the plan figure is the one recorded.
binding_note: 1 TB a month on a 200 Mbps port is the number that runs out first on this plan.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the sign-up form was not read; the /register.php path returned 404. The vendor's forum post lists credit or debit cards, PayPal and cryptocurrency as payment methods.

reliability_note: unverified: no outage history was read; trumvps.com returned a broker-side HTTP 530 and the live sites read were trumvps.vn and support.trumvps.vn.
confidence_note: Shape comes from the vendor's cart page; the USD price and the Hanoi location come from the vendor's own forum post, because the cart page shows no USD price and no location. Reading a plan page with prices would raise this to documented.
